title: Lookup Table Dynamic
text: Approximate a one-dimensional function using dynamic table, 3 inputs, 1 output, direct feedthrough, {Output data type} sets Output data type; {Lookup Method} sets the lookup method Interpolation-Use End, {Lock output data type setting against changes by the fixed-point tools} sets the option to prevent fixed-point tools from overriding Output data, {Integer rounding mode} sets the rounding mode for fixed-point operations and {Saturate to max or min when overflows occur} sets the method of overflow action. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: xdat
ports.summary: breakpoint data 1-by-n vector of strictly monotonically increasing values

ports.name: y
ports.summary: Approximation of y = f(x) using dynamic table data 1-by-n vector

params.name: Lookup Method
params.values: Specify the lookup method Interpolation-Use End Values (default) | Interpolation-Extrapolation | Use Input Nearest | Use Input Below | Use Input Above

params.name: Output data type
params.values: Output data type double (default) | ’Inherit: Inherit via back propagation’ | single | int8 | uint8 | int16 | uint16 | int32 | uint32 | int64 | uint64 | boolean | fixdt(1,16,0) | fixdt(1,16,2^0,0) |

params.name: Lock output data type setting against changes by the fixed-point tools
params.values: Option to prevent fixed-point tools from overriding Output data type off (default) | on

params.name: Integer rounding mode
params.values: Rounding mode for fixed-point operations Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Simplest | Zero

params.name: Saturate to max or min when overflows occur
params.values: Method of overflow action off (default) | on
